scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @devtodo/web build && pnpm --filter @devtodo/desktop build && pnpm --workspace-root exec tsx scripts/desktop-package.ts
